verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.langchain.com (HTTP 200) describing LangSmith documentation. Per-page markdown versions (e.g., home.md) are also served, and they point agents to the llms.txt index. The llms.txt also lists OpenAPI specs, giving agents machine-readable API docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents consume these docs effectively, and no llms-full.txt or detailed agent-oriented usage guidance evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
